subject: Acme - Post-call: procurement path & security checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme - Post-call: procurement path & security checklist

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and the suggested next steps so procurement has what it needs to move us forward: 

Key takeaways from the call:
- Pilot scope: 3 devs + staging integration, approx 250k tokens/month for evaluation
- Success criteria: latency < 150ms P50 on typical prompts, deterministic cost estimates for pilot
- Security gating: Acme requires SOC 2 attestation, a signed DPA, and answers to a security questionnaire for vendor onboarding

Immediate actions (from Redwood):
1) Share SOC 2 attestation and our DPA (attached) — action: Marissa (today)
2) Provide a completed security questionnaire — action: Rafael (security/SE) by EOD Thursday
3) Clarify commercial path: PO vs card and whether AWS Marketplace is preferred — action: Samantha/Tom to confirm
4) If PO, please share procurement lead and typical PO terms (net30/45, W-9 needed?)

Attachments: redwood-soc2-attestation.pdf, redwood-dpa.docx (see attachments list). Rafael will also attach our security questionnaire responses in a follow-up.

Question for you: do you prefer to procure via AWS Marketplace (simpler for many of your teams) or direct vendor PO? Either works for us; we want to align on billing and timeline so we can prepare a mutual action plan.

Proposed timeline:
- This week: deliver security artifacts and questionnaire answers
- Next week: procurement reviews and legal review of DPA
- Week after: onboarding + initial pilot provisioning

If helpful, we can set a short procurement/technical Q&A this week — Rafael and I are available.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - Post-call: procurement path & security checklist

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few notes from procurement side: 

- Procurement prefers to use PO for any vendor engagement over $10k/month. Our standard is net30 but we can escalate if needed.
- We are evaluating whether to buy via AWS Marketplace (preferred by our Cloud team) vs direct PO/credit card. Marketplace shortens vendor onboarding but may add markup; need to confirm pricing options.
- Vendor onboarding timeline: security review + legal review typically ~10 business days once we have SOC 2 + signed DPA + questionnaire answers. We can try to accelerate to ~5 business days if the artifacts are complete and we have a named billing contact.

Action items for us:
- I will confirm Marketplace interest with the Cloud team by Friday (14 May).
- Please send SOC 2 and DPA (and questionnaire) ASAP — procurement will start the vendor intake when those are received.
- Billing contact: please CC our finance lead (procurement@acme.com) on DPA/contract for review.

Thanks,
Samantha
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme, Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - Post-call: procurement path & security checklist

Hi Samantha — thanks. Attaching the requested artifacts here: 
- redwood-soc2-attestation.pdf (latest date 2026-03)
- redwood-dpa.docx (we can sign via DocuSign; link below)

DocuSign link for DPA (editable for legal): https://docusign.example/sign/redwood-dpa-acme

Rafael will follow up with our completed security questionnaire (we included common control mappings and evidence references). Quick answers to your Marketplace/PO questions: 
- We support AWS Marketplace procurement (we publish via private offers for enterprise deals). If you prefer Marketplace, pricing can be presented as a private offer and the billing flows through your AWS invoice (often faster for Cloud teams).
- For direct PO, we accept vendor PO and can invoice net30 by default. We can also accept card for initial pilot if that helps speed things up.

Proposed mutual action plan: 
1) Today: we sent SOC2 & DPA + questionnaire in follow-up from Rafael
2) Procurement starts vendor intake on receipt of artifacts
3) Legal review of DPA (DocuSign link) — please let us know redlines or your standard addendum
4) Once PO approved or Marketplace private offer accepted, we’ll provision pilot capacity (2–3 business days)

Please confirm preferred commercial path (Marketplace vs PO vs card) and who should be the signatory on the DPA/contract.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - Post-call: procurement path & security checklist

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Attaching our completed security questionnaire response (redwood-security-questionnaire-response.xlsx). A few technical notes that often come up in vendor reviews: 
- Data handling: we do not persist customer prompt/response data beyond configured retention; customer-managed retention and optional KMS/HSM for key management are available in Private deployments.
- SOC 2 scope: covers production inference service, control environment, and change management — see attestation for scope details.
- Network isolation: private deployments can sit inside customer VPCs; hosted API supports VPC peering for dedicated customers where required.

If procurement or your security team would like a short technical Q&A, happy to schedule a 30-min call this week.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - Post-call: procurement path & security checklist

Thanks Marissa / Rafael — this is very helpful.

Quick update from our side:
- Cloud team confirmed Marketplace as preferred for pilot. Please proceed with a private offer option and share pricing for that route.
- Procurement will start vendor intake today; expected timeline ~7–10 business days with SOC2 + DPA + questionnaire on file.
- We will use PO (net30) for the pilot if Marketplace pricing is not advantageous — procurement will advise.

Next steps for Redwood: share Marketplace private offer pricing OR confirm PO invoicing terms and provide a billing contact to procurement. Also, please route the DocuSign DPA to procurement@acme.com and copy me.

I’ll follow up once procurement confirms exact timeline.

Best,
Samantha
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme, Inc.
